description: Defines the ViewMyAttendanceController class, a controller responsible for preparing and rendering the 'view-my-attendance' Vue component within the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. It manages request parameters and availability of modification permissions.
published: OrangeHRM	hotrophies	hotrophies rom OrangeHRM	hotrophies	hotrophies rom

classes.name: ViewMyAttendanceController
classes.description: Controller for handling attendance view logic, extending AbstractVueController, utilizing traits for attendance services, and preparing Vue components based on request parameters and permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with relevant properties based on the incoming HTTP request, checking if a date parameter exists and if the user has permission to modify attendance, then sets the component for rendering.
